note: Pad -> PLC input mapping. Device names are the PLC's own labels (octal numbering: X7 is followed by X10). In design v4 the pad state reaches X10-X14 through the Pico (GPIO -> opto module), not directly from the switches. The game sends one byte over Web Serial to the Pico (step-five/js/plc.js): bits 0-2 = score level 0..5 -> X15..X17, bit 3 = combo lamp -> X0.

reserved.outputs: Y0-Y3 pulse/direction for a possible motor
